purpose: Add an app-owned ACM artifact-instruction ingestion manifest builder that computes hashes for artifact-like zip entries and selects the next follow-up gate without running POD.
behavior_locked_by_tests: candidate bytes plus hash material choose acm_candidate_bytes_hash_mapping_gate

pod_usage.reason: Local artifact-instruction classification only. POD is used only in a later provenance gate after artifact entries are mapped to paper workloads and reviewed.

allowed_summary: Goal5336 adds an app-owned ACM artifact-instruction ingestion manifest builder for a future real ACM supplement zip. It computes per-entry hashes for artifact-like files and selects a follow-up gate without running POD.
not_allowed: claiming the real ACM supplement has been inspected from synthetic tests
claiming exact paper dataset reproduction from this manifest alone
claiming Figure 5 reproduction from this manifest alone
claiming full X-HD paper reproduction from this manifest alone
claiming author-vs-RTDL performance ratio from this manifest alone
running POD directly from this manifest
